post.text: It’s a remarkable coincidence that the Earth was exactly the same orientation to the moon with exactly the same cloud coverage when these two pictures were taken 68 years apart. Am I now a coincidence theorist ? https://t.co/BzxpS8y3M6

description.description: A split-screen image comparing two views of Earth rising over the lunar horizon. The left side shows the historic 'Earthrise' photo from the Apollo 8 mission in 1968, appearing somewhat grainier and smaller. The right side shows a modern, high-resolution simulation or mock-up of the same view for the upcoming Artemis 2 mission in 2026, where the Earth appears much larger and more detailed.
